translations.web: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.
translations.bsb: It has frustrated every effort; its thick rust has not been removed, even by the fire.
translations.kjv: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
translations.asv: She hath wearied herself with toil; yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her; her rust goeth not forth by fire.
